# Angular conventions (Angular 22, standalone, zoneless)

## Folder layout (feature-first)
```
frontend/src/app/
  core/                 # app-wide singletons: country context, http, error handling
  shared/ui/            # reusable presentational components (no business logic)
  features/<feature>/   # one folder per feature, e.g. country-selection, quote-form, plan-list, summary
    <feature>.page.ts   # routed container component
    components/         # presentational components of this feature
    data/               # API service + models (*.model.ts) + mappers
    state/              # signal-based store for the feature, if needed
    *.spec.ts           # tests next to the code they test
```

## Components
- Standalone only, `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`, no NgModules.
- `input()`, `output()`, `model()` signal APIs; `inject()` instead of constructor injection.
- Templates use `@if`, `@for` (always with `track`), `@switch`. No `*ngIf` / `*ngFor`.
- Container (page) components talk to services/state; presentational components only receive inputs and emit outputs.
- Every async view handles three states: loading, error (with retry), empty.

## State
- `signal()` / `computed()` for state; `linkedSignal()` / `resource()` / `httpResource()` when they simplify async data.
- RxJS only where streams are genuinely needed (e.g. debounced input). Convert at the edge with `toSignal()`.
- Wizard state that must survive back-navigation or refresh lives in one store per wizard, persisted to `sessionStorage` through a single persistence helper. Never store tokens there.

## HTTP and contracts
- Call only relative URLs (`/api/...`). No hosts, no tokens, no `environment.ts` secrets.
- Strapi responses are mapped to app models in `data/*.mapper.ts`; components never see raw Strapi shapes.
- Models mirror the Strapi schema (source of truth). Any schema change updates the model in the same commit.

## Forms
- Typed Reactive Forms (`FormGroup<{...}>`, `nonNullable`) or Signal Forms if stable in the installed version — decided once in the plan, then consistent.
- Dynamic form: config from CMS → typed field descriptors → validators built by a pure function (`buildValidators(field)`) that is unit-tested per rule.
- Error messages come from configuration, shown next to the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.

## Accessibility (mandatory)
- Every control has a visible `<label for>`; help text and errors linked via `aria-describedby`; invalid fields get `aria-invalid="true"`.
- The whole wizard is operable by keyboard; on step change, move focus to the step heading.
- Use native elements (`button`, `input`, `select`) before ARIA roles.

## Styling
- BEM class names: `block__element--modifier`. SCSS per component; design tokens as CSS custom properties in `styles.scss`.
- Mobile-first; layouts must work from 320px width.

## Testing
- Vitest unit tests for: validators, mappers, price rules, stores, critical component interactions.
- No tests for styles, static templates or scaffolding.
- Name tests after requirements: `describe('US-01 · FR-003 vehicle year range', ...)`.
- Prefer testing pure functions; for components use `TestBed` with harness-free DOM queries by role/label.

# Strapi conventions (Strapi 5, TypeScript, SQLite)

## Content types live in code
- Every content type and component is defined as schema files under `cms/src/api/<name>/content-types/<name>/schema.json` and `cms/src/components/<category>/<name>.json`.
- Never rely on changes made only through the admin Content-Type Builder: they are not reviewable. If one is made in dev, commit the generated files.
- Use `draftAndPublish: true` for business-managed content so only published entries reach the app.
- Field names in camelCase; descriptive names (`basePrice`, not `price1`).

## Country differentiation
- The strategy is defined in the multi-country ADR in `docs/adr/`. Read it before modelling any content type and follow it exactly. Do not introduce a second mechanism.

## Querying (Strapi 5)
- Server code uses the Document Service API: `strapi.documents('api::x.x').findMany({ filters, populate, status: 'published' })`.
- REST responses in Strapi 5 are flat (no `data.attributes`); entries are identified by `documentId`.
- Populate explicitly what the frontend needs; never `populate=*` in production paths.

## Security and permissions
- The browser only reads. The Public role gets `find` / `findOne` on exactly the content types the wizard reads — nothing else, no `create/update/delete`.
- Permissions are granted in code at bootstrap (`cms/src/index.ts`), so a fresh database is configured identically. List each granted action with a comment saying why.
- No API tokens are created by code. No token of any kind reaches the frontend.
- Never read, print or commit `.env`; document new variables in `.env.example` only.

## Seed data
- Seed runs at bootstrap only when the database is empty, is idempotent, and lives in `cms/src/seed/` (one file per content type, data per country).
- Fictitious data only (no real people, documents or plates).
- Seeded entries are published so the app works right after `docker compose up`.
- An admin user for local development may be created from `.env` variables; defaults are dev-only and documented in the README.

## Contract
- The schema is the source of truth for the API contract. When a field is added/removed/renamed, report it so the Angular models in `frontend/src/app/features/*/data/` are updated in the same commit.
- Breaking changes to an existing contract require human approval (constitution §3.3).

## Verification
- `npm --prefix cms run build` must pass before reporting.

# UI/UX guidelines

Visual language derived from research of the public car-insurance sites of a reference LatAm insurer operating in Colombia and Chile (2026-11-21). We reuse its **patterns and token values**, never its assets: no third-party logos, fonts or images in the repo. The product is a fictitious insurtech with its own text wordmark.

## 1. Design tokens

Defined once as CSS custom properties in `frontend/src/styles.scss`. Components use tokens only — no raw hex values.

```scss
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --color-brand: #0033a0;          /* navy: header, wordmark, info */
  --color-action: #2d6df6;         /* buttons, links, plan names */
  --color-action-hover: #26328c;
  --color-cta: #e3e829;            /* main CTA background only */
  --color-cta-hover: #d7de17;
  --color-on-cta: #26328c;         /* text on yellow */
  --color-accent: #00aec7;         /* DECORATIVE ONLY, never text (2.7:1) */

  /* Text & surfaces */
  --color-text: #1c1c24;
  --color-text-muted: #53565a;
  --color-surface: #ffffff;
  --color-surface-alt: #f8f8f8;    /* cards */
  --color-surface-highlight: #dfeaff; /* recommended plan, badges */
  --color-border: #cdced9;
  --color-disabled-bg: #e7e7e7;
  --color-disabled-text: #666666;   /* 4.6:1 on disabled-bg (Sura's #878789 was 2.9:1) */

  /* Status (fg / bg) */
  --color-error: #d12d35;   --color-error-bg: #fff4f3;
  --color-success: #067014; --color-success-bg: #def6de;
  --color-warning: #ed8b00; --color-warning-bg: #fff5ec;
  --color-info: #0033a0;    --color-info-bg: #e0eaff;

  /* Spacing (4px base) */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px;
  --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px; --space-12: 48px;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 8px;      /* inputs */
  --radius-md: 16px;     /* cards */
  --radius-pill: 999px;  /* buttons, badges */

  /* Elevation */
  --shadow-card: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  --shadow-soft: 0 8px 25px rgba(83, 89, 144, 0.07);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0, 56, 255, 0.22);
}
```

## 2. Typography

- **Font:** Figtree from the Google Fonts CDN, only the weights we use, with `display=swap`:
  ```html
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  ```
- **Fallback (lightweight, no download):** `--font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;`
- **Scale (mobile → desktop):**

| Role | Size | Weight | Color |
|------|------|--------|-------|
| Price / hero heading | 32px → 48px | 700 | `--color-text` |
| Step heading (`h1`) | 24px → 32px | 700 | `--color-brand` |
| Section / card title | 20px | 700 | `--color-action` |
| Body | 16px, line-height 1.5 | 400 | `--color-text` |
| Label, badge, helper | 14px | 500 | `--color-text-muted` |

- Never below 14px. Blue text (`--color-action`) only at ≥16px.

## 3. Component recipes (BEM)

Each component defines: default, hover, focus-visible, disabled and (if applicable) error/selected states.

**Button** — `.button`, `.button--cta`, `.button--primary`, `.button--secondary`
- Pill (`--radius-pill`), min-height 48px, padding `--space-3 --space-6`, 16px / 700.
- `--cta`: yellow bg, navy text. One per screen: the step's main action (Continue, Pay).
- `--primary`: action-blue bg, white text, hover `--color-action-hover`.
- `--secondary`: white bg, 1px navy border (Back, Edit).
- Disabled: `--color-disabled-bg` / `--color-disabled-text` (≥ 4.5:1), plus `aria-disabled` or `disabled`. Loading: keep width, show spinner + "Procesando…", `aria-busy="true"`.

**Choice tile** — `.choice-tile`, `--selected`: large single-choice option (e.g. country). Native radio inside a `<label>`.
- Default: `--color-surface`, 2px `--color-border`, `--radius-md`, min-height 96px, flag above name, name 20px/700 `--color-text` (black, never brand or white).
- Hover: border `--color-action` only. Never a background change or dark fill.
- Selected: 2px `--color-action` border + bg `--color-surface-highlight` + check icon absolutely positioned in the top-right corner (not color alone; no extra text, so selecting causes no layout shift). The native radio announces the checked state.
- Focus: `--focus-ring`. All text states ≥ 4.5:1.

**Form field** — `.form-field`, `__label`, `__control`, `__help`, `__error`, `--invalid`
- Label above the control, 14px/500; required marked with `*` and announced (`required` attribute).
- Control (soft filled, chosen at US-01 Gate 2): min-height 52px, 16px text (prevents iOS zoom), `--color-surface-brand-soft` fill, 12px top radius, no side borders, 2px bottom line `--color-text-muted` (≥3:1 against the fill). Focus: bottom line `--color-action`, fill `--color-surface-field-focus` (`#e8f0ff`), plus `--focus-ring` on `:focus-visible`. Invalid: bottom line `--color-error`.
- Placeholder only as an example (`Ej: ABC123`), never as the label.
- Error: icon + text in `--color-error` below the control, `aria-describedby` linked, `aria-invalid="true"` on the control.
- **Select** (`.select-field`): never the native option list. A `role="combobox"` trigger with the same soft-filled look and a chevron that rotates when open, plus a `role="listbox"` popup: white, 14px radius, `--shadow-card`, 6px padding; options 10px/12px padding, 10px radius, `--color-surface-brand-soft` for the active option, selected option bold `--color-on-cta` with a check icon. Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox: ↑/↓, Home/End, Enter/Space to pick, Esc to close, Tab to leave; `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`.
- Yes/No and short choices: segmented toggle built on native radio inputs (`.segmented`, `__option`, `--checked`).

**Form card** — `.form-card`: `--color-surface`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-card`, padding `--space-6`, max-width 560px, centered. Title 20px/700 `--color-action`.

**Plan card** — `.plan-card`, `__badge`, `__radio`, `__name`, `__price`, `__section`, `__item`, `--recommended`, `--selected` (agreed at US-02 Gate 2)
- White `--color-surface`, 14px radius, padding `--space-4`/`--space-6`, 1px inset ring `--color-border`. No top stripe and no grey background.
- `--recommended`: a 5px `--color-brand` top border, a 1px brand ring, and a large `__badge` pill ("Recomendado" with a star icon; 16px bold text, an 18px icon, 6px × 18px padding; `--color-cta` bg, `--color-on-cta` text) centred **on the top border**. Only the first recommended plan in order.
- `--selected`: a `__radio` circle filled with `--color-action` and a white check, plus a 2px **inset** `--color-action` ring. No "Seleccionado" text: nothing may change size or position (no layout shift). The radio state is the non-colour cue.
- The cards share one CSS subgrid, so the name and description, the price (after a divider), Coberturas and Beneficios start on the same line in every card.
- Price: large, `--color-brand`, formatted in the country's currency with no decimals, followed by "/ mes". No text explaining how the price is calculated.
- Sections: Coberturas and Beneficios with check icons; an empty list is hidden.
- Selectable as a radio group, one choice only; the arrow keys move the choice.
- The "Continuar" pill is disabled (`--color-disabled-bg` / `--color-disabled-text`) until a plan is chosen, with no hint text.

**Stepper** — `.stepper`, `__step`, `--current`, `--done`: numbered steps with text labels in an `<ol>`, above the form card; current step has `aria-current="step"`. Current and done circles (32px): `--color-surface-highlight` fill, 2px `--color-action` ring, `--color-brand` number (check icon when done); upcoming: white, 1.5px `--color-border` ring, `--color-text-muted`. Current label bold `--color-brand`; connector lines 2px, `--color-action` up to a done step, else `--color-border`. On mobile show only the current circle + "Paso 2 de 3" + current label.

**Motion** — content loads with a skeleton, then items fade up 14px one by one (600ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`, 110ms stagger), only on first render, never on validation re-renders. Popups open with a 160ms fade/slide. All of it is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**Summary block** — `.summary-section` with a title + "Editar" secondary link per section (data, vehicle, plan). Masked document shown as `•••• 5678`.

**States**
- **Loading:** skeletons shaped like the final content (cards, fields); `aria-busy` on the region.
- **Empty** (e.g. no plans): flat illustration or icon, friendly headline, one-line explanation, one action.
- **Error** (e.g. payment rejected, CMS down): `--color-error-bg` panel with icon, what happened, what to do, and a retry button. Never lose user data.
- **Success** (confirmation): `--color-success` check icon, headline, quote number prominent and copyable.

## 4. Accessibility (non-negotiable)

- Contrast: text ≥ 4.5:1. `--color-accent` never carries text; white on `--color-action` only at ≥16px bold.
- Visible `:focus-visible` on every interactive element (`--focus-ring`). Never `outline: none` without replacement.
- Touch targets ≥ 48×48px.
- Information never by color alone (selected, recommended, error all have text/icon).
- On step change, move focus to the step heading; announce async errors with `role="alert"`.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (no transitions).

## 5. Layout

- Mobile-first. Breakpoints are Bootstrap's: sm 576, md 768, lg 992, xl 1200 px. Custom media queries use the same values.
- **Layouts use Bootstrap 5.3 grid and utilities** ([ADR 0003](../../../docs/adr/0003-bootstrap-grid-for-layouts.md)) on every screen. Bootstrap is for layout only:
  - Page width: every screen's content sits in a `.container`, capped at 1140 px (global override), with Bootstrap's gutters.
  - Structure: `.row` / `.col-*` (`.col-12 .col-md-6`, …) for columns that stack on mobile.
  - Alignment and spacing: `.d-flex`, `.flex-column`, `.justify-content-*`, `.align-items-*`, `.gap-*`, `m-*` / `p-*`, `.text-center` / `.text-md-start`, `.d-none .d-md-block`.
  - Never use Bootstrap colour, typography, border, shadow or component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.bg-*`, `.text-primary`, `.fs-*`…). Those come from our tokens and BEM recipes.
  - Component SCSS holds component styling only (look, states, internal spacing with `--space-*`), not page layout.
- Plan cards: a Swiper slider below 992px (about 1.2 cards on mobile, 2.2 on tablet, with previous/next arrows and dots, opening on the recommended plan, no loop and no autoplay; only the load animation); a 3-column grid from 992px.
- Header: navy bar with text wordmark; no navigation beyond the wizard.

## 6. Imagery

- Hero/decoration: optional. If used, fictitious stock-style photos of real-looking people relaxed with car/phone, or flat illustrations with soft blobs in brand blue, yellow and cyan.
- Empty/error states: simple flat illustration or large icon, never a stock photo.
- Decorative images: `alt=""`. Informative images: alt describes the content.
- Only images we are licensed to use (own SVGs, open-licensed illustrations). No assets from third-party sites.

## 7. Copy tone (Spanish, both countries)

- Informal "tú", warm, short sentences. CTAs as actions: "Continuar", "Ver planes", "Pagar ahora".
- Errors say what to do: "Ingresa una placa válida, por ejemplo ABC123."
- Country vocabulary comes from the CMS (placa vs patente, cédula vs RUT) — never hard-code it.

## 8. Design options in plan.md (Gate 2)

For each client-facing view, propose 2–3 options that **vary layout or interaction, not the visual language** (all use these tokens and components). Format per option:

```
### Option A — <name>
- Layout: <one or two lines, mobile and desktop>
- Pros / Cons: <...>
- Accessibility notes: <...>
**Recommendation:** Option X, because <...>
```

Examples of meaningful variations: form in one long card vs. grouped sections (policyholder / vehicle); plan cards side by side vs. comparison table; summary as cards vs. single list with inline edit links.

# Project Context & Rules

Always read and follow `.specify/memory/constitution.md` before planning, writing code, or running commands.
The full agentic flow (steps, gates, agents) is described in `FLOW.md`.

## Repository Structure
- `cms/`: Headless CMS built with Strapi 5 (TypeScript, SQLite). Content types, APIs, seed, permissions.
- `frontend/`: Angular 22 app (TypeScript, ESLint), Vitest unit tests next to the code, Playwright e2e in `frontend/e2e/`.
- `docs/user-stories/`: Functional user stories pasted verbatim by the human (`US-XX.md`). Never edited by AI.
- `docs/adr/`: Architecture Decision Records (MADR), `NNNN-<slug>.md`.
- `specs/NNN-us-XX-<slug>/`: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `analysis.md`, `review.md` per user story (Spec Kit).
- `.claude/agents/`: subagent definitions. `.claude/skills/`: skills.
- `ai-logs/`: exported agent sessions. Never edit.

## Verification Commands
- **Frontend (lint + typecheck + unit tests):** `npm --prefix frontend run verify`
- **Frontend build:** `npm --prefix frontend run build`
- **Frontend e2e (Playwright):** `npm --prefix frontend run e2e`
- **CMS build / typecheck:** `npm --prefix cms run build`
- **CMS unit tests:** `npm --prefix cms test`
- **CMS dev server:** `npm --prefix cms run develop`
- **Full stack:** `docker compose up --build`

## Stack Rules (all agents)
- **Angular:** standalone components only, no NgModules; signals for state; built-in control flow (`@if`, `@for`, `@switch`); typed forms; no `any`. Details: `angular-conventions` skill.
- **Strapi:** schemas defined in code; Public role gets only `find`/`findOne` on what the wizard reads. Details: `strapi-conventions` skill.
- **Security:** no Strapi token of any kind in the frontend; the browser calls only relative `/api/...` URLs (proxied by nginx / `proxy.conf.json`).
- **Layout:** Bootstrap 5.3 grid and utilities only (containers, grid, flex, spacing), never its colour, typography or component classes. Details: `ui-ux-guidelines` skill §5, ADR 0003.
- **Accessibility:** every field has a visible label; the wizard is fully keyboard-operable; works on mobile and desktop.
- **Data:** fictitious data only. No real personal data, documents, plates or credentials anywhere in the repo.

## Plan Phase Additions (Gate 2)
`plan.md` must also contain, when applicable:
- **Unit test candidates:** list the unit tests worth writing (business logic, validations, calculations, data mapping, critical interactions; never trivial rendering or getters), each with **what** it checks and **why** it matters, as a table (ID `UT-NN`, area, what, why). Table-driven tests state their example count. The human marks each one **Approved** or **Rejected** at Gate 2. Developer agents write only approved unit tests; a regression test for a bug found after Gate 2 (review finding or Gate 3 correction) is allowed and must be named in its task.
- **E2E candidates:** list only critical flows that deserve an e2e test, each with a one-line justification. The human marks each one **Approved** or **Rejected** at Gate 2. The `e2e-tester` agent runs only for approved candidates.
- **Design options:** for every client-facing view, 2–3 design options based on the `ui-ux-guidelines` skill, with a recommendation. The human picks one at Gate 2.
- **ADRs:** every architectural decision gets an ADR in `docs/adr/` (context, alternatives, consequences), linked from `plan.md`.
- **Revisions:** when the human rejects or corrects the plan at Gate 2, append an entry to a `## Revisions` section at the end of `plan.md`: date, what the human asked to change, and what changed. Never delete entries.

## Asking the Human
- Every question to the human (Gate 1 clarify questions, Gate 2 choices, stop conditions) MUST be asked with the interactive question tool (`AskUserQuestion`): one question per call, 2–4 options, the recommended one first with "(Recommended)" in its label, and a self-contained question text (the human may see only the dialog).
- Never put a question and its options only in prose: in the desktop app, text written before the end-of-turn summary can be collapsed and the human never sees it.
- After the answer, repeat the question and the chosen answer in plain text so they stay in the session log.

## Traceability
- The user story ID `US-XX` appears in: spec folder name, spec header, each task line, ADR "Related" field, test names (`describe('US-XX · FR-XXX …')`), and commit footer `Refs: US-XX`.
- Requirements in `spec.md` are numbered `FR-XXX`; tasks and tests reference them.
- Gate approvals are recorded in the artifact header: `**Status**: Approved (Gate 1|2) — <date>`. Gate 3 is recorded as the last line of `review.md`: `Gate 3: Approved — <date>`.
- Human corrections: Gate 1 in `spec.md` › Clarifications, Gate 2 in `plan.md` › Revisions, Gate 3 as new tasks in `tasks.md`.

## Security & Workflow Hygiene

# Angular conventions (Angular 22, standalone, zoneless)

## Folder layout (feature-first)
```
frontend/src/app/
  core/                 # app-wide singletons: country context, http, error handling
  shared/ui/            # reusable presentational components (no business logic)
  features/<feature>/   # one folder per feature, e.g. country-selection, quote-form, plan-list, summary
    <feature>.page.ts   # routed container component
    components/         # presentational components of this feature
    data/               # API service + models (*.model.ts) + mappers
    state/              # signal-based store for the feature, if needed
    *.spec.ts           # tests next to the code they test
```

## Components
- Standalone only, `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`, no NgModules.
- `input()`, `output()`, `model()` signal APIs; `inject()` instead of constructor injection.
- Templates use `@if`, `@for` (always with `track`), `@switch`. No `*ngIf` / `*ngFor`.
- Container (page) components talk to services/state; presentational components only receive inputs and emit outputs.
- Every async view handles three states: loading, error (with retry), empty.

## State
- `signal()` / `computed()` for state; `linkedSignal()` / `resource()` / `httpResource()` when they simplify async data.
- RxJS only where streams are genuinely needed (e.g. debounced input). Convert at the edge with `toSignal()`.
- Wizard state that must survive back-navigation or refresh lives in one store per wizard, persisted to `sessionStorage` through a single persistence helper. Never store tokens there.

## HTTP and contracts
- Call only relative URLs (`/api/...`). No hosts, no tokens, no `environment.ts` secrets.
- Strapi responses are mapped to app models in `data/*.mapper.ts`; components never see raw Strapi shapes.
- Models mirror the Strapi schema (source of truth). Any schema change updates the model in the same commit.

## Forms
- Typed Reactive Forms (`FormGroup<{...}>`, `nonNullable`) or Signal Forms if stable in the installed version — decided once in the plan, then consistent.
- Dynamic form: config from CMS → typed field descriptors → validators built by a pure function (`buildValidators(field)`) that is unit-tested per rule.
- Error messages come from configuration, shown next to the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.

## Accessibility (mandatory)
- Every control has a visible `<label for>`; help text and errors linked via `aria-describedby`; invalid fields get `aria-invalid="true"`.
- The whole wizard is operable by keyboard; on step change, move focus to the step heading.
- Use native elements (`button`, `input`, `select`) before ARIA roles.

## Styling
- BEM class names: `block__element--modifier`. SCSS per component; design tokens as CSS custom properties in `styles.scss`.
- Mobile-first; layouts must work from 320px width.

## Testing
- Vitest unit tests for: validators, mappers, price rules, stores, critical component interactions.
- No tests for styles, static templates or scaffolding.
- Name tests after requirements: `describe('US-01 · FR-003 vehicle year range', ...)`.
- Prefer testing pure functions; for components use `TestBed` with harness-free DOM queries by role/label.

# UI/UX guidelines

Visual language derived from research of the public car-insurance sites of a reference LatAm insurer operating in Colombia and Chile (2026-11-21). We reuse its **patterns and token values**, never its assets: no third-party logos, fonts or images in the repo. The product is a fictitious insurtech with its own text wordmark.

## 1. Design tokens

Defined once as CSS custom properties in `frontend/src/styles.scss`. Components use tokens only — no raw hex values.

```scss
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --color-brand: #0033a0;          /* navy: header, wordmark, info */
  --color-action: #2d6df6;         /* buttons, links, plan names */
  --color-action-hover: #26328c;
  --color-cta: #e3e829;            /* main CTA background only */
  --color-cta-hover: #d7de17;
  --color-on-cta: #26328c;         /* text on yellow */
  --color-accent: #00aec7;         /* DECORATIVE ONLY, never text (2.7:1) */

  /* Text & surfaces */
  --color-text: #1c1c24;
  --color-text-muted: #53565a;
  --color-surface: #ffffff;
  --color-surface-alt: #f8f8f8;    /* cards */
  --color-surface-highlight: #dfeaff; /* recommended plan, badges */
  --color-border: #cdced9;
  --color-disabled-bg: #e7e7e7;
  --color-disabled-text: #666666;   /* 4.6:1 on disabled-bg (Sura's #878789 was 2.9:1) */

  /* Status (fg / bg) */
  --color-error: #d12d35;   --color-error-bg: #fff4f3;
  --color-success: #067014; --color-success-bg: #def6de;
  --color-warning: #ed8b00; --color-warning-bg: #fff5ec;
  --color-info: #0033a0;    --color-info-bg: #e0eaff;

  /* Spacing (4px base) */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px;
  --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px; --space-12: 48px;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 8px;      /* inputs */
  --radius-md: 16px;     /* cards */
  --radius-pill: 999px;  /* buttons, badges */

  /* Elevation */
  --shadow-card: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  --shadow-soft: 0 8px 25px rgba(83, 89, 144, 0.07);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0, 56, 255, 0.22);
}
```

## 2. Typography

- **Font:** Figtree from the Google Fonts CDN, only the weights we use, with `display=swap`:
  ```html
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  ```
- **Fallback (lightweight, no download):** `--font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;`
- **Scale (mobile → desktop):**

| Role | Size | Weight | Color |
|------|------|--------|-------|
| Price / hero heading | 32px → 48px | 700 | `--color-text` |
| Step heading (`h1`) | 24px → 32px | 700 | `--color-brand` |
| Section / card title | 20px | 700 | `--color-action` |
| Body | 16px, line-height 1.5 | 400 | `--color-text` |
| Label, badge, helper | 14px | 500 | `--color-text-muted` |

- Never below 14px. Blue text (`--color-action`) only at ≥16px.

## 3. Component recipes (BEM)

Each component defines: default, hover, focus-visible, disabled and (if applicable) error/selected states.

**Button** — `.button`, `.button--cta`, `.button--primary`, `.button--secondary`
- Pill (`--radius-pill`), min-height 48px, padding `--space-3 --space-6`, 16px / 700.
- `--cta`: yellow bg, navy text. One per screen: the step's main action (Continue, Pay).
- `--primary`: action-blue bg, white text, hover `--color-action-hover`.
- `--secondary`: white bg, 1px navy border (Back, Edit).
- Disabled: `--color-disabled-bg` / `--color-disabled-text` (≥ 4.5:1), plus `aria-disabled` or `disabled`. Loading: keep width, show spinner + "Procesando…", `aria-busy="true"`.

**Choice tile** — `.choice-tile`, `--selected`: large single-choice option (e.g. country). Native radio inside a `<label>`.
- Default: `--color-surface`, 2px `--color-border`, `--radius-md`, min-height 96px, flag above name, name 20px/700 `--color-text` (black, never brand or white).
- Hover: border `--color-action` only. Never a background change or dark fill.
- Selected: 2px `--color-action` border + bg `--color-surface-highlight` + check icon absolutely positioned in the top-right corner (not color alone; no extra text, so selecting causes no layout shift). The native radio announces the checked state.
- Focus: `--focus-ring`. All text states ≥ 4.5:1.

**Form field** — `.form-field`, `__label`, `__control`, `__help`, `__error`, `--invalid`
- Label above the control, 14px/500; required marked with `*` and announced (`required` attribute).
- Control (soft filled, chosen at US-01 Gate 2): min-height 52px, 16px text (prevents iOS zoom), `--color-surface-brand-soft` fill, 12px top radius, no side borders, 2px bottom line `--color-text-muted` (≥3:1 against the fill). Focus: bottom line `--color-action`, fill `--color-surface-field-focus` (`#e8f0ff`), plus `--focus-ring` on `:focus-visible`. Invalid: bottom line `--color-error`.
- Placeholder only as an example (`Ej: ABC123`), never as the label.
- Error: icon + text in `--color-error` below the control, `aria-describedby` linked, `aria-invalid="true"` on the control.
- **Select** (`.select-field`): never the native option list. A `role="combobox"` trigger with the same soft-filled look and a chevron that rotates when open, plus a `role="listbox"` popup: white, 14px radius, `--shadow-card`, 6px padding; options 10px/12px padding, 10px radius, `--color-surface-brand-soft` for the active option, selected option bold `--color-on-cta` with a check icon. Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox: ↑/↓, Home/End, Enter/Space to pick, Esc to close, Tab to leave; `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`.
- Yes/No and short choices: segmented toggle built on native radio inputs (`.segmented`, `__option`, `--checked`).

**Form card** — `.form-card`: `--color-surface`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-card`, padding `--space-6`, max-width 560px, centered. Title 20px/700 `--color-action`.

**Plan card** — `.plan-card`, `__badge`, `__radio`, `__name`, `__price`, `__section`, `__item`, `--recommended`, `--selected` (agreed at US-02 Gate 2)
- White `--color-surface`, 14px radius, padding `--space-4`/`--space-6`, 1px inset ring `--color-border`. No top stripe and no grey background.
- `--recommended`: a 5px `--color-brand` top border, a 1px brand ring, and a large `__badge` pill ("Recomendado" with a star icon; 16px bold text, an 18px icon, 6px × 18px padding; `--color-cta` bg, `--color-on-cta` text) centred **on the top border**. Only the first recommended plan in order.
- `--selected`: a `__radio` circle filled with `--color-action` and a white check, plus a 2px **inset** `--color-action` ring. No "Seleccionado" text: nothing may change size or position (no layout shift). The radio state is the non-colour cue.
- The cards share one CSS subgrid, so the name and description, the price (after a divider), Coberturas and Beneficios start on the same line in every card.
- Price: large, `--color-brand`, formatted in the country's currency with no decimals, followed by "/ mes". No text explaining how the price is calculated.
- Sections: Coberturas and Beneficios with check icons; an empty list is hidden.
- Selectable as a radio group, one choice only; the arrow keys move the choice.
- The "Continuar" pill is disabled (`--color-disabled-bg` / `--color-disabled-text`) until a plan is chosen, with no hint text.

**Stepper** — `.stepper`, `__step`, `--current`, `--done`: numbered steps with text labels in an `<ol>`, above the form card; current step has `aria-current="step"`. Current and done circles (32px): `--color-surface-highlight` fill, 2px `--color-action` ring, `--color-brand` number (check icon when done); upcoming: white, 1.5px `--color-border` ring, `--color-text-muted`. Current label bold `--color-brand`; connector lines 2px, `--color-action` up to a done step, else `--color-border`. On mobile show only the current circle + "Paso 2 de 3" + current label.

**Motion** — content loads with a skeleton, then items fade up 14px one by one (600ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`, 110ms stagger), only on first render, never on validation re-renders. Popups open with a 160ms fade/slide. All of it is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**States**
- **Loading:** skeletons shaped like the final content (cards, fields); `aria-busy` on the region.
- **Empty** (e.g. no plans): flat illustration or icon, friendly headline, one-line explanation, one action.
- **Error** (e.g. payment rejected, CMS down): `--color-error-bg` panel with icon, what happened, what to do, and a retry button. Never lose user data.
